name: Humanism
overview: Humanism, particularly secular humanism, emphasizes human reason and values apart from God, but Scripture clearly teaches that mankind is created in God's image and is inherently sinful, falling short of God's glory. While humanism often exalts human wisdom and autonomy, the Bible calls believers to obey God rather than men and to offer themselves as living sacrifices in response to God's mercy. Ultimately, salvation and true righteousness come only through faith in Jesus Christ, whom God gave out of love for the world.
